name: ChatGPT to PDF
description: Export ChatGPT conversations to clean PDFs while preserving code, tables, images, and mathematical formatting.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http:; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'
